svg.title: Tatawwu Bahrain — project design specification
svg.text: Orange = App · Green = routed page · Yellow = wrapper or child component · Arrows = direct children
TATAWWU' / BAHRAIN / ENGLISH / MERN + JWT + CLOUDINARY
15 URL patterns map to 14 routed page components. CampaignEditorPage serves both
create and edit. CertificatePreview is a nested component, not a separate frontend
Arrows connect direct parent and child components. Yellow components have no
client-side route. Shared components may appear more than once to show each parent
Country is fixed to BH; activity time displays in Asia/Bahrain. Role guards organize
frontend navigation. Express checks authentication, roles and record ownership on
Shared controls: Button · FormField · GovernorateSelect · AreaFilter · StatusBadge · ConfirmDialog · LoadingState · EmptyState · ErrorState
